title: All sensors of a group should be visible in Sensors Details section of widget settings immediately after adding the group
line: Picking a "[Group]" sensor in System Monitor widget settings now immediately adds one labelled entry per matching sensor instead of a blank chip.
explanation: Group entries in the sensor picker have a regular expression as their sensor id (e.g. cpu/cpu\d+/usage). Choices.qml pushed that pattern as one selected sensor, and since a pattern has no sensor name the chip showed no label; the pattern was only expanded to the real sensors by the controller's SensorResolver after applying and reopening the settings. Now, when a group entry is picked, the picker walks its sensor tree model, adds every sensor whose id matches the pattern (sorted by name, numbers compared naturally, respecting the field's sensor limit), and falls back to the old behaviour if nothing matches.

commits.message:
faces/choices: add every sensor of a group when picking it

Picking a "[Group]" entry added its sensor id pattern as a single entry,
which has no name, so only an unlabelled chip appeared until the settings
were reopened. Now the matching sensors are added one by one instead.

BUG: 442702

media.caption: Master: picking [Group] CPU > [Group] Total Usage adds a single unlabelled chip (sweep tester's shot, kdetest4).
Fixed: the same pick immediately adds labelled Core 1, Core 2, Core 3… Total Usage chips.
Popup closed: all 16 cores listed in order, before applying.
Saved widget after restart: per-core sensors, Total Sensors limited to 2 for the pie chart, plus a plain text-only sensor.
